not_applicable.reason: The tool writes no credential file and creates no credential folder, so cases perm-001, perm-002 and perm-003 do not apply. The warning on read applies and is met.

The tool has no config check command. A run that collects Workspace usage prints one line that names the credential source and the masked client ID. Cases with the config_check command are skipped, except those that test only a profile read.
The tool has no live test command. Workspace collection is optional and reports a failed lookup as one fixed category.
The tool has no live test command, so it has no product access message.
The AHD_ variable names belong to aa-health-duckdb only.

differences.summary: cja-lineage --live accepts a profile name of up to 128 characters and passes it to cja_auto_sdr. It builds no path from the name. sdr-visualizer --profile applies the 64 character rule.

A file with a key that the tool does not know is rejected, not ignored. A profile may also hold sandbox, which is ignored. The tool removes spaces around each scope and removes repeated scopes before it sends them.
Workspace collection does not read AA_PROFILE or CJA_PROFILE. It prints the notice profile_variable_not_used and uses the environment variables.
Workspace collection does not read .env in the working folder.
Workspace collection has no default config file. A config file is read only when --workspace-usage-config names it.
When no source gives a credential, the worker reports one input error that does not name the ways to give one.
A partial set of environment variables stops the run, as the rule asks, but the error does not name the missing fields. A partial profile does name them.
